about: Exploration arms: one arm is one lane, model and effort. lane refuses an arm that is absent or retired unless --off-catalog; lane-stats pick samples only active arms. Add or override arms (same lane, model, effort) in ~/.config/lanes/arms.local.json. prior_pct is a guess at the share of the provider's weekly window one run takes on prior_plan's base window (before window_epochs), prior_usable a guess at its usable rate (Artificial Analysis coding-agent index v1.5 / 80); both give way to measured runs. lane-stats turns every weekly % into a share of today's window on today's plan (plan_scale, then window_epochs) and prices it in plan dollars (plan_prices; see explore.points_basis). weight scales how often exploration samples the arm.

terra.prior_basis: No Artificial Analysis coding-agent entry (2026-10-28). prior_pct: sol's at the same effort x terra's cost per task over sol's (AA Intelligence Index v5.0 comparison pages: 0.44 low, 0.47 medium, 0.44 high). prior_usable: sol's at the same effort x terra's index over sol's (29/35, 38/46, 42/50). Suite R (planted key) measured low, medium and high on 2026-10-28; reviewed runs replace the rest.

fable.role: advisor and worker: role calls through lane --role (plan, ladder, final-review, tiebreak, user); its active arms are also drawn by the picker for hard and design units, which run as role work (the owner, 2026-11-10: Fable 5.2 does real work first, judged by reviewed outcomes on real units; the Suite R comparison against Opus waits for spare allowance at the end of a week)

codex.basis: plan_scale is the base windows, before window_epochs: measured Pro Lite ≈ 8,400 credits a week (usage-lab U3, 2026-10-19) and Plus ≈ 1,450 (U1), so a Plus run takes 5.8x the % of a Pro Lite run. Since 2026-10-29 16:56 UTC Pro Lite is about 16,800 credits a week (window_epochs: limits doubled; the meter fell 6% to 3% with no spend), so today a Plus run takes about 11.6x; Plus is not reported doubled. Three measured waves on a plan replace the prior; a window epoch's scale applies to runs read on or after its from time.

prices.source: Claude API reference, cached 2026-10-06; Sonnet and Haiku cache writes and the Haiku cache read follow its 1.25x / 2x / 0.1x rule

gemini.basis: Google AI Pro ($19.99 a month), plenty spare; scarcity 0.2 applies only to a plan without a price

cursor.basis: No account-wide meter exists; cost comes from priors and per-run tokens.

grok.basis: No account-wide meter exists; cost comes from priors and per-run tokens.

amp.basis: No account-wide Amp meter exists; each run's cost comes from `amp threads usage` (Amp's recorded cost, which a linked provider subscription can record as $0) or from its priced tokens.

amp.subagent_basis: On Amp a subagent run is an agent thread the kit plugin's kit_lane_run tool starts (amp.createAgent, Agent.run). Only these lanes, and only models of these providers (Amp's model list, plans/amp-codex/probe/P1.md), run there; Codex, gemini, cursor, grok and glm stay processes

explore.points_basis: Cost points are plan dollars. A run's cost is its share of the provider's weekly window, as a % of today's window on today's plan (plan_scale, then window_epochs), / 100 x the plan's usd_per_month / weeks_per_month, times the usage mode's pace factor. A provider or plan without a price (cline; Codex 'pro') pays share x scarcity x Claude's plan dollars per 1% of its week (200 / 4.345 / 100 = $0.46). review_points and fix_points_per_minute stay in Claude-% (1 = 1% of Claude's week) and convert at that rate: a review costs about $0.0046 and a fix minute about $0.0014; pace does not apply to them. Without a Claude price every term stays in Claude-%.

time.basis: 151 untagged real units on one machine to 2026-10-29 (FINDINGS §16): class medians rounded, design between substantive and hard; a ridge fit put terra at 0.39x the other lanes (n=10) and could not separate effort from lane, so effort factors are mild; residual log-sd 1.2. The brief-size term (minutes x (brief bytes / 6000)^0.8) is the fitted slope of the log error on log brief size over 183 units with a known brief (correlation 0.40); in a time-ordered backtest it cut the median error factor from 1.89 to about 1.7. A run's own tag, class and arm history replace these as runs accumulate.

memory.basis: Rough priors from one Windows snapshot on 2026-10-29: interactive Claude Code sessions held 640-670 MB each, the Codex app-server about 50 MB, and the worker's own tool commands (tests, builds) come on top. A lane's need is the median peak_mem_mb of its last recent_runs runs once it has min_runs of them; these priors only cover the first runs. The reserve keeps the main session and the desktop usable.

advisor.budget_basis: Fable list dollars over the last 7 days, every role but user (picked work included). $120 is about 15% of Claude's week and 29% of the Fable 5.2 cap ($410) at the measured 0.122% of the week per Fable list dollar (FINDINGS section 20). The gate also stops role calls at fable_guard_pct of Fable's own bar
